target_customer: Product and marketing teams who need launch videos and motion graphics
problem: Making product launch animations is slow and needs design skills; Midrender uses an AI agent plus an editable timeline.
business_model: SaaS subscription (a directory lists a 20 dollar monthly plan, unverified)

founders.name: Konstantin Hohr
founders.background_notes: From the YC page; the page does not say he founded Midrender specifically but lists him as the only active founder.

technical_complexity.rationale: Video rendering and a timeline editor built on open source Motion Canvas, with an AI agent layer added later.

defensibility.rationale: Built on open source animation libraries with many AI video tools; no data or network moat evidenced.

market_need_then: Demand for programmatic and templated video was shown by the open source Revideo project, but dated evidence for Midrender itself was not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and concise, says AI motion graphics you can still edit by hand

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: AI motion graphics you can still edit by hand

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand material found.

outcome_analysis: Midrender is a one person company from Summer 2023 whose founder also built the open source Revideo library. It now sells an AI motion graphics editor. No funding, exit or traction figures are public, so no outcome story is supportable beyond it being active.
